@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The star is so close to the earth that it is visible to the n______d eye.
= naked
~詞義 naked（adj.）裸露的;赤裸的
~原文 The star is so close to the earth that it is visible to the naked eye.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Be careful when you use s______rs. Watch your fingers!
= scissors
~詞義 scissors（n.）剪刀
~原文 Be careful when you use scissors. Watch your fingers!

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: A man suddenly r______hed into the classroom and started yelling at one of our classmates.
= rushed
~詞義 rush（v.）衝
~原文 A man suddenly rushed into the classroom and started yelling at one of our classmates.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: When cooking chicken in a pot, make sure to leave the lid slightly open in order to let the s______m out.
= steam
~詞義 steam（n.）水蒸氣
~原文 When cooking chicken in a pot, make sure to leave the lid slightly open in order to let the steam out.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: O______p of personal property is a basic right that all people should have.
= ownership
~詞義 ownership（n.）所有權
~原文 Ownership of personal property is a basic right that all people should have.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The little bird almost fell out of its ______. Fortunately, its mother caught it at the last second.
A: crab
B: pile
C: dawn
D: nest
= D
~詞義 nest（n.）鳥巢
~原文 The little bird almost fell out of its nest. Fortunately, its mother caught it at the last second.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: At the port, a(n) ______ lifted a huge, heavy container and moved it onto the ship.
A: ox
B: log
C: crane
D: moth
= C
~詞義 crane（n.）起重機
~原文 At the port, a(n) crane lifted a huge, heavy container and moved it onto the ship.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Someone broke into the company's ______ yesterday and stole some important information.
A: volleyball
B: rectangle
C: pigeon
D: database
= D
~詞義 database（n.）資料庫
~原文 Someone broke into the company's database yesterday and stole some important information.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The volunteers worked from ______ to dusk, clearing garbage and delivering supplies after the powerful typhoon struck the country.
A: dawn
B: bull
C: straw
D: moth
= A
~詞義 dawn（n.）黎明
~原文 The volunteers worked from dawn to dusk, clearing garbage and delivering supplies after the powerful typhoon struck the country.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: After the main course came the delicate ______—strawberry cheesecake.
A: dessert
B: parrot
C: napkin
D: loser
= A
~詞義 dessert（n.）甜點
~原文 After the main course came the delicate dessert—strawberry cheesecake.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: parrot
B: neat
C: blew
D: monster
E: coughed
F: log

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: At noon, the workers sat on a huge ______ and had lunch.
= F
~詞義 log（n.）圓木
~原文 At noon, the workers sat on a huge log and had lunch.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The travel show introduced the famous ______ in the lake, attracting tourists curious about strange animals and unexplained legends.
= D
~詞義 monster（n.）怪物
~原文 The travel show introduced the famous monster in the lake, attracting tourists curious about strange animals and unexplained legends.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Johnny always keeps his house ______ and tidy.
= B
~詞義 neat（adj.）整潔的
~原文 Johnny always keeps his house neat and tidy.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: After choking on the spicy pepper, David ______ up small bits of food while trying to catch his breath again.
= E
~詞義 cough（v.）咳出某物(cough up sth.)
~原文 After choking on the spicy pepper, David coughed up small bits of food while trying to catch his breath again.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ is a tropical bird that can copy the human voice and other sounds.
= A
~詞義 parrot（n.）鸚鵡
~原文 The parrot is a tropical bird that can copy the human voice and other sounds.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: bare
B: pitched
C: underwear
D: omitted
E: piled
F: underlying

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Before turning in his answer card, the student checked it again to see if he had ______ any questions.
= D
~詞義 omit（v.）遺漏
~原文 Before turning in his answer card, the student checked it again to see if he had omitted any questions.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Most people only focus on the main plot of movies. Personally, I find it more interesting to analyze their ______ themes.
= F
~詞義 underlying（adj.）隱含的
~原文 Most people only focus on the main plot of movies. Personally, I find it more interesting to analyze their underlying themes.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: After you wash your ______, make sure to dry it out completely.
= C
~詞義 underwear（n.）內衣
~原文 After you wash your underwear, make sure to dry it out completely.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: After class, the students ______ their homework books neatly on the teacher's desk.
= E
~詞義 pile（v.）堆疊
~原文 After class, the students piled their homework books neatly on the teacher's desk.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The player ______ the ball with incredible speed, impressing every spectator.
= B
~詞義 pitch（v.）投擲
~原文 The player pitched the ball with incredible speed, impressing every spectator.
